narrative.overview: A calm editorial page — bone paper, Caslon headlines, generous margins, 1px rules — where every technical detail is precise and quietly placed rather than performed. Warmth comes from the paper and the voice; competence comes from structure, alignment and the one place the system goes dark (the stack band). Light by default: visitors read this on a laptop at work or on a phone between meetings, so daylight paper is right. Structure comes from rules and alignment, not boxes; cards are used sparingly (projects, the diagnostic price panel, the mini-diagnostic and the contact form) and never as the page scaffold.
keyCharacteristics: Bone paper (#F7F4EE) with near-black ink and exactly one accent, pine.
Libre Caslon Display headlines over Public Sans body; system mono only for job names and tech tags.
1px hairline rules carry the structure; flat surfaces, no shadows.
Exactly one night band: the technology stack. The footer is light.
Motion is a single reveal grammar plus one choreographed moment (the pipeline).

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Pine is the only hue. No gradients, glass, glow, colored shadows or purple.

rules.name: The One Night Rule
rules.body: `night` is used by exactly one band, the stack. Every other surface, the footer included, is bone or bone-deep.

rules.name: The Monochrome Logos Rule
rules.body: Third-party logos render monochrome in `night-text` (featured row at 100%, grid at 80% opacity), never in brand colors. The SVG is decorative; the visible name under it is the accessible name.

rules.name: The One Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The hero eyebrow ("Experiencia enterprise, atención cercana") is a pinned brand commitment and the only eyebrow on the page. Section headings carry their own weight.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks things a machine would name (job names, tech tags), never decoration.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If two things need separating, draw a 1px hairline or change tone; never add a shadow.

dos: Do let 1px rules and whitespace carry structure; keep pine the only accent.
Do use the shared container (`max-w-[1200px] px-4 lg:px-6`) and the 64/96/128px section rhythm.
Do show real things only: real projects, real photo, typographic placeholders otherwise.
Do keep technical vocabulary inside the stack band, pipeline job names, project tags and the cloud service.
donts: Don't add a second `night` surface (the footer included).
Don't build rows of identical icon cards, a centered hero over cards, gradients, glass, glow, shadows, stock imagery or colored third-party logos.
Don't use pine for large fills beyond the primary button and small status marks.
Don't add eyebrows above section headings.
